steps.name: 2. Pick the picture itself, to tune it

findings.title: Choose a file can't be reached from the keyboard
findings.repro: Start screen: press Cmd+O (nothing); press Tab repeatedly (never lands on "Choose a file").
findings.expected: Cmd+O opens a file, as in Photoshop; or at least Tab reaches "Choose a file" and Enter opens the chooser.
findings.actual: Cmd+O does nothing. "Choose a file" is a label around a hidden file input, so it is not in the Tab order at all (41 Tabs never reached it) and the aria tree shows it as plain text, not a button. From the keys there is no way to open a picture.

findings.title: A quick second tap on a layer is lost
findings.step: 2. Pick the picture itself, to tune it
findings.repro: Open photo.jpg on a touch tablet; tap Layer 1, then within a quarter second tap Base: Layer 1 is still picked.
findings.expected: Each tap on a layer row picks that row.
findings.actual: A tap on Base within about 300 ms of a tap on Layer 1 is lost: Layer 1 stays picked (150 ms and 250 ms gaps lost the tap; 400 ms and 600 ms picked Base). Quick taps between rows, as she flips back and forth, silently do nothing.

findings.title: The help i never opens on a tablet
findings.step: Free time: Getting the picture in
findings.repro: On a touch tablet open photo.jpg, pick Base, tap the i beside Choose characters (or any i in the left column): nothing appears.
findings.expected: Tapping the i beside a setting shows its help, as hovering does with a mouse.
findings.actual: On a touch screen a tap fires mouseenter (show) and then click (toggle), so the tooltip opens and closes in the same tap: no help ever shows. The i is also a 12x12 px target, not focusable and not a button (aria shows a bare "i"), so neither touch nor keyboard can read any of the left column's help.

findings.title: There is no PNG export
findings.repro: Open a photo, look for Export PNG on every tab, in the Actions menu, and on a long press of the canvas.
findings.expected: A PNG export of the art as it shows; Vector shapes (Saving) lists "Exports (.ans, PNG, GIF and the rest)".
findings.actual: There is no PNG export: not in the left column, not on SAUCE, not in Actions, no key. A long press on the canvas only paints. The only exports are .ans and .utf8ans (GIF only with Animate on, per the docs).

goals.goal: Open a photo from the keys in three presses or fewer.
The help is readable on a tablet.
goals.evidence: Tapping the help i never opens its tooltip (1-F8).
